eval: (async () => { const required = { asr: ['start', 'sendFrame', 'events', 'stop'], llm: ['generateObject', 'generateText'] }; const response = await fetch('/api/device/capabilities'); const body = await response.json(); const capabilities = body.data; const ready = (domain, operations) => operations.every(operation => capabilities?.[domain]?.some(item => item.operation === operation && item.declared === true && item.status === 'available')); if (!response.ok || !body.ok || !ready('asr', required.asr) || !ready('llm', required.llm)) throw Error('Host ASR/LLM capabilities incomplete; no paid task submitted'); return capabilities; })()

eval: (async () => { const deadline = Date.now() + 120000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.table__body .row')]; const target = rows.filter(r => /REC20261029_150[12]00.mp3/.test(r.innerText)); if (target.length === 2 && target.every(r => r.querySelector('.col-status')?.innerText === '待归类')) return target.map(r => r.innerText); if (target.some(r => r.querySelector('.col-status')?.innerText === '失败')) throw Error('Batch ASR failed'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); } throw Error('List did not refresh to transcribed'); })()

(async () => { const list = await fetch('/api/recordings').then(r => r.json()); const details = await Promise.all(window.__batchIds.map(id => fetch('/api/recordings/' + id).then(r => r.json()))); if (!list.ok || list.data.hasActiveTasks || details.some(b => !b.ok || b.data.recording.status !== 'transcribed' || !(b.data.recording.transcriptChars > 0) || !b.data.transcript?.text.includes('评审') || b.data.lastError || !b.data.segments.length || !b.data.jobs.some(j => j.kind === 'transcribe' && j.status === 'success' && j.finishedAt))) throw Error('Batch ASR readback failed'); return { list, details }; })()

(async () => { const list = await fetch('/api/recordings').then(r => r.json()); const details = await Promise.all(window.__batchIds.map(id => fetch('/api/recordings/' + id).then(r => r.json()))); if (!list.ok || list.data.hasActiveTasks || details.some(b => { const d = b.data, r = d?.recording, a = d?.analysis; return !b.ok || r.status !== 'organized' || d.lastError || !r.title || !r.summary || !r.categoryId || !r.categoryName || !r.tags.length || !(r.transcriptChars > 0) || !d.segments.length || !a?.keyPoints.length || !a.actionItems.length || !a.categorySlug || !Number.isInteger(r.importance) || r.importance < 1 || r.importance > 5 || !d.jobs.some(j => j.kind === 'organize' && j.status === 'success' && j.finishedAt); })) throw Error('Batch organization readback failed: ' + JSON.stringify(details)); return { list, details }; })()
